w3_baseline.commit_message: feat: M2.9 W3 - candidate intake, canonical comparison, placement manifest

canonical_workflow.notes: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL -> IMPLEMENTING transition already defined in VALID_TRANSITIONS dict. State docstrings confirm W4 responsibility: 'Implementation approval pending (Human Gate 2, Placement Approval).' Transition enforcement via is_valid_transition() function.

approval_model.notes: No ImplementationApproval model found. app/models/ contains: workflow_target.py, task_state.py, governance.py, evidence.py, creation.py, candidate.py. W4 must create new model.

approval_route.notes: STUB implementation found with WAVE 4 comment marker. Implements manifest hash verification, contract hash verification, state transition enforcement, and self-approval prevention. Uses WorkflowApprovalPayload model. Helper functions register_workflow_for_approval() and transition_to_approval_gate() exist. W4 must extend/complete this stub, not create new route.

placement_manifest.notes: PlacementManifest dataclass has manifest_sha256 field (computed via _compute_manifest_seal()). Manifest includes: manifest_id (UUID), candidate_sha256, target_family, target_version, file_paths, replacement_strategy, rollback_plan, generated_at, manifest_sha256.

candidate_validator.notes: ValidationResult has sha256 field (computed from file content). CandidateValidator._compute_candidate_hash() performs real SHA-256 computation in 4096-byte blocks.

evidence_infra.pattern: EvidenceRecord model with evidenceId, scannerName, timestamp, claim, contentHash fields
evidence_infra.notes: Evidence model exists for TypeScript snapshot evidence. W4 approval decisions should produce machine-readable evidence in similar format. Use JSON files in .agents/tasks/ for W4 evidence (pattern established by W3).

authorization_module.notes: No app/authorization/ directory exists. W4 must create services/project-ai/app/authorization/approval_checker.py for placement executor authorization hook.

w4_implementation_scope: Create ImplementationApproval domain model in app/models/implementation_approval.py
Complete/extend approve-placement endpoint in governance.py (stub exists with W4 marker)
Wire transition authorization into canonical_workflow.py (transition rule exists, must add approval verification)
Create app/authorization/approval_checker.py for placement executor hook
Add tests for approval flow, self-approval rejection, hash mismatch rejection, unauthorized transition blocking

architectural_findings.stub_quality: High quality stub with correct verification gates: manifest hash, contract hash, state machine enforcement, self-approval prevention. WorkflowApprovalPayload model complete. Helper functions exist.
architectural_findings.evidence_pattern: W3 established pattern: JSON evidence files in .agents/tasks/ with status, commit, test_results, examples, architectural_compliance fields
architectural_findings.test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio. Tests use real assertions (pytest.raises, assert conditions). No mocked passes.
architectural_findings.workflow_state_storage: In-memory _workflow_states dict in governance.py. Production will use database.
architectural_findings.approval_binding_fields: governance.py stub already includes: workflow_id, manifest_hash, contract_hash, approved_by. Must add: candidate_sha256, target_family, target_version, placement_manifest_id.

validation_rules: approved_by cannot equal workflow requester (self-approval prevention)
All hash/ID fields immutable after approval granted
